# githubsettings_repository_secret_scanning_validity_checks (Resource)

Record the current secret scanning validity check status for this repository. Set `status` to the value GitHub reports for your repository. If the plan shows a difference, check the status in GitHub before applying. Apply fails while the configured status differs. Use a token with repository Administration read access.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

Read the current values with the GitHub CLI. Set [`GITHUB_TOKEN`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#authentication) first so this command and Terraform use the same token. Replace `OWNER` and `REPOSITORY`.

```shell
GH_TOKEN="${GITHUB_TOKEN:?Set GITHUB_TOKEN first}" gh api --hostname github.com repos/OWNER/REPOSITORY \
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
  --jq '.security_and_analysis.secret_scanning_validity_checks.status'
```

Use the reported `enabled` or `disabled` as `status`. If the result is empty or `null`, check the repository's security settings and confirm that the account can see the [security settings in the repository API response](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository). An absent value does not indicate `disabled`.

Add the import block below to a Terraform project configured with `elephant-evergreen/githubsettings`. The [quickstart](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#import-a-policy) shows the provider block and initialization. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_repository_secret_scanning_validity_checks.example
  id = "example-owner/example-repository"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with arguments that match the current GitHub values.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes a change, compare the differing values with the current policy and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_secret_scanning_validity_checks" "example" {
  owner      = "example-owner"
  repository = "example-repository"
  status     = "enabled"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.
- `status` (String) Secret scanning status. Allowed values are enabled, disabled.
